requirements.text: Students should be able to book study rooms via a mobile application or web interface, selecting date, time, and the number of occupants, with conflict resolution features suggesting alternative times if necessary.
The system should allow students to check book availability and manage loans, including viewing borrowed books, due dates, and online renewals.
A reminder feature should send notifications or emails a few days before due dates to help students avoid late fees.
The system should automatically calculate late fines and provide a clear list of outstanding fines for students.
Students should receive notifications regarding any fines added to their accounts and have the ability to pay fines online.
The system must ensure that the booking process is simple and straightforward.
The system must be accessible from mobile devices.
